name: dragon-background
description: Local background images for Codex desktop on Windows.

interface.longDescription: Display a local image behind the Codex chat pane on Windows. Choose your own PNG, JPEG, or static WebP and adjust transparency, image size, fit, and position in native plugin settings. Uses a verified localhost desktop debugging connection; enabling it after a normal launch asks before restarting the app. Requires Node.js 24+ and the Windows Store Codex desktop distribution. Experimental desktop customization; app updates may change compatibility. The bundled GPT dragon-girl wallpaper is an AI-assisted adaptation of ZipZipPipe’s character/reference art, for non-commercial use with attribution and source notices. Read Artwork credits & license in settings. Unofficial; not affiliated with OpenAI or the original artist.

positive.description: Read settings after an ordinary launch.
positive.prompt: Show the current DragonGirlBackground settings without enabling it.
positive.expected_behavior: The effective switch is off when no verified localhost debug connection exists. No window is closed or opened.

positive.description: Save display settings on a debug-enabled host.
positive.prompt: Set background transparency to 40% and image scale to 80%.
positive.expected_behavior: Values persist after rereading. The image updates in the chat pane, and native inputs remain usable.

positive.description: Select a local image using the native file picker.
positive.prompt: Let me choose another local background image.
positive.expected_behavior: A local picker accepts a PNG, JPEG, or static WebP. Cancel leaves the old image; selecting a valid image preserves the existing background switch.

positive.prompt: Who created the dragon girl, and what are the artwork usage terms?
positive.expected_behavior: Credit ZipZipPipe, show the original source URLs, identify ccy1430’s AI adaptation, and explain attribution and non-commercial use. Do not call the GPT artwork CC0 or CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
The wallpaper is removed, the off preference is saved, and the single background worker exits. The chat window remains open.

negative.prompt: Use https://example.com/background.png directly as my background.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject remote URLs without fetching them, without changing the saved selection, and without opening a restart confirmation.

negative.prompt: Enable the background on a normal launch, but choose No in the restart dialog.
negative.expected_behavior: No restart, new app instance, or preference change occurs after No. Never close the app without explicit confirmation.

negative.prompt: Set transparency to 120% and scale to 10%.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject out-of-range values; retain the old settings and report the accepted ranges.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, ads, or payment processing. The bundled character artwork is restricted to non-commercial use.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.2: Rename the product to DragonGirlBackground across the listing, MCP title, credits, and documentation. Retain the 75% transparency, 100% scale, contain, centered default profile.

zh-CN.description: Windows 桌面背景插件：支持本地选图、透明度、缩放和位置设置。普通启动时背景显示关闭，开启前询问是否重启。内置 GPT 龙娘改编图仅限非商业使用，须保留 ZipZipPipe 署名和来源。需要 Node.js 24+。非 OpenAI 官方插件。
